Subject: On-call shifts go to 3 days starting June 2

Hi team,

Starting June 2, on-call shifts will be 3 days long instead of a full week.

A lot of you have said week-long shifts wear you out, especially when incidents stack up toward the end of the week. We think shorter shifts will help with that. They should also make it easier to plan your time off and keep response quality steady from start to finish.

There are 9 engineers in the rotation, so you'll be on call roughly once every 27 days. That's more often than now, but each shift is a lot shorter. You'll also get a $150 bonus for every shift you complete.

The new schedule will be in the team calendar by the end of next week. Please check your dates as soon as it's posted. If something conflicts, work out a swap with a teammate and tell your manager at least 48 hours before the shift starts.

If you have questions or concerns, reply here or bring them up at the next team sync.

Thanks for everything you do to keep things running.

Best,
[Your Name]
Engineering Operations
